profile.summary: AHS Staffing is a healthcare staffing agency founded in 2010 and based in Edmond, Oklahoma. It places traveling nurses, dialysis staff and allied health professionals in temporary assignments. Through its PediaStaff division it also places school and pediatric therapists, such as speech-language pathologists and occupational and physical therapists.
